Error: Global built-in functions are deprecated and will be removed in Dart Sass 3.0.0.
Use color.adjust instead.

More info and automated migrator: https://sass-lang.com/d/import

This is only an error because you've set the global-builtin deprecation to be fatal.
Remove this setting if you need to keep using this feature.
